text:
Vanessa Ortiz: Kicking off Provision-to-ready automation sprint. Goal for this week: lock baseline + stage owners + targets. Links:
- Linear kickoff ENG-2741: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2741/provision-to-ready-automation-kickoff
- Confluence overview: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ENGINFRA/Provision-to-ready+automation+overview

Here’s the baseline Jamal pulled from last 10 Dedicated bring-ups (rough, pls sanity check):
- end-to-end time-to-ready: p50 ~ 19.4h, p95 ~ 44.8h
- biggest contributors: Imaging + Bootstrap variability, plus “waiting on humans” during validation/ready marking

Proposed stage buckets (what we’ll instrument + gate):
1) Provisioning (IaC/TF)
2) Imaging (golden image applied / node prep)
3) Bootstrapping (k8s + helm/runtime components)
4) Validating (gpu/net/tls + smoke)
5) Perf-canary (readiness suite)
6) Ready (control plane marks + routing consumes)

Can folks reply w/ owner for each stage + any dependencies? :point_down:

Irene Choi: :thumbsup: Thanks. +1 that baseline needs to include “human latency” too (handoff gaps). We should be explicit what’s in vs out for “time-to-ready” metric.

Jamal Pierce: Sharing more detail from the baseline sheet (will clean this up into the Drive doc later today):
- Provisioning (TF apply / quotas / IAM): median 1h20m, p95 4h10m
- Imaging: median 4h05m, p95 15h30m (big region+SKU skew; artifact mirror slowness shows up)
- Bootstrap (cluster + charts): median 2h40m, p95 6h55m (mostly retries / values mismatches)
- Validation (gpu health + net): median 1h10m, p95 5h
- “Ready marking” + routing enable: median 35m, p95 3h (usually waiting on someone to eyeball + flip)

Also: 2/10 runs had a full-day delay due to quota escalation. We should track quota as separate “blocked” reason so we don’t pretend automation fixes procurement.

Aisha Bello: For metrics, can we align now on definition:
- start: pool enters Requested (control plane) OR TF apply start?
- end: control plane Ready set (and eligible for routing) OR first successful routed request?

My preference:
- time-to-ready SLO: Requested -> Ready (control plane)
- plus a separate “time-to-first-routed” for safety checks / routing propagation.

Rafael Mendes: +1. SRE preference: Ready must imply safe to route, no manual toggles. If we keep a manual “enable in routing” step, we’ll keep getting long tails.

Nina Petrova: Ownership proposal (infra side):
- Provisioning / TF orchestration: Gabe + me (module structure + outputs)
- Bootstrap: Gabe (helm chart pinning + cluster bootstrap hooks)

Dependencies: we need standard TF outputs (cluster endpoint, node pool IDs, security group IDs, region, sku) consumed by the orchestrator service.

Gabe Wilson: Yep. I can own Provisioning wrapper + idempotency + retries, but I’ll need someone to review the TF module refactor PRs in redwood-terraform.

Also proposing we define state machine transitions in control plane early so we can emit events: Requested → Provisioning → Imaging → Bootstrapping → Validating → Ready/Failed.

Victor Alvarez: I can own networking readiness checks in Validating:
- DNS
- TLS handshake to control plane endpoints
- egress allowlist sanity check (artifact mirror + helm repos)

Would be good to get an “expected endpoints per region” list in config schema so checks aren’t hardcoded.

Kira Thompson: I’ll take runbooks + operator docs for the new pipeline + CLI. If owners can drop “common failure modes” as they implement, I’ll fold into a single troubleshooting section.

Connor O'Brien: For rollout gating: let’s ship behind a staging-only flag first. Week 4 we can do 1-2 internal pools + 1 customer expansion (w/ rollback). I’ll coordinate the release checklist + comms.

Talia Benson: I can keep the workstreams unblocked + do the weekly status notes. Vanessa, want me to set up a single doc w/ stage owners + daily update bullets?

Vanessa Ortiz: Yes please. Also dropping tentative stage owners below — react if this is wrong.

Stage owners (draft):
- Provisioning (IaC/TF orchestration): Gabe + Nina
- Imaging (golden image build/promotion + image apply): (need confirmation) Sahana + Keiko
- Bootstrapping (k8s bootstrap + helm/runtime): Gabe
- Validating (GPU health + net/TLS/smoke): Victor + Rafael
- Perf-canary integration: Rina (needs hooks from bootstrap)
- Ready semantics (control plane + routing consumption): (need confirmation) Ethan + Ravi
- Metrics/events/dashboards: Aisha + Logan + Caleb
- Runbooks/CLI UX notes: Kira

Targets (week 1 output):
- baseline doc w/ p50/p95 + top 5 delay causes
- stage timing budget proposal (so we can alert on “stuck”)

RedwoodBot: reminder set by Vanessa Ortiz: “post stage owners + week 1 targets” in this thread at 4pm today.

Rafael Mendes: For validation pass/fail, we should define hard criteria now so it’s not subjective:
- GPU health: no ECC errors above threshold, nvidia-smi stable, DCGM diag basic suite pass
- Network: DNS ok, artifact mirror reachable, control-plane heartbeat ok
- Runtime smoke: can load model + generate short tokens under X sec (even if perf-canary later)

If any fail, mark stage Failed w/ error category. No more “looks fine to me” approvals.

Aisha Bello: On “stuck” alerts, we can start simple:
- if stage duration > budget * 2 AND no progress events in 30m -> page? or ticket?
We can debate paging thresholds later, but we should emit events consistently from day 1.

Jamal Pierce: Tentative stage budgets (based on baseline medians, leaving headroom):
- Provisioning: 2h
- Imaging: 6h
- Bootstrap: 3h
- Validating: 2h
- Perf-canary: 45m
- Control plane Ready -> routing eligible: 15m

Total target: ~14h (vs current p50 19.4h). p95 goal I’d love to get under 24h but we’ll see.

Irene Choi: Directionally good. Let’s not overpromise p95 until we handle Imaging variance + quota blocks. But I do want a committed “internal SLA” we can message to Sales/CS once pilot stabilizes.

Vanessa Ortiz: Great. Action items:
1) Jamal + Aisha: baseline + metric definition draft by EOD tomorrow.
2) Gabe + Nina: stage machine / TF outputs list in Linear.
3) Victor + Rafael: validating checklist + failure categories.
4) Connor + Kira: pilot/rollback checklist skeleton.

Everyone: please add yourselves as owners on ENG-2741 sub-issues as they go up. :pray:
